battle.name: 第一次巴巴利戰爭
battle.brief: 一八〇一年五月，美國與的黎波里因年貢金額談崩，正式開火；往後四年，的黎波里、阿爾及爾、突尼斯三地的私掠船隊與美國分遣小艦隊在地中海反覆交鋒。輪發手槍在北非軍械庫中已屬舊藏，機械昂貴又須鑰匙上弦，真正上陣的是燧發手槍與前裝滑膛火槍。

kit.name: 輪發手槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方並非兩個國家，而是「北非巴巴利聯盟」與美國兩個體系對峙。巴巴利一方由三個自治城邦國家組成：的黎波里是主戰場，一八〇一年由優素福·卡拉曼利執政，他以「德伊」之名統治，麾下有由商人、海員與軍官代表組成的議會與「迪萬」稅務機構，首都的黎波里的海軍由二十餘艘槳帆快船與縱帆輕巡航艦組成，裝六至十二磅長管炮與旋轉小炮，是地中海中部航線的實際控制者；阿爾及爾實力最強，私掠船隊由數十艘到近百艘不等，一八〇一年在穆斯塔法統治下應的黎波里之請出兵相助；突尼斯的穆拉德王朝船隊較小，但同樣以劫掠為生，一八〇一年也向美國宣戰；摩洛哥蘇門於一八〇〇年十月因商船稅務爭端向美國宣戰，翌年一月雙方在華盛頓簽訂條約而未交兵。美國一方是成立未久的共和國：國會撥款、海軍部承辦，實際作戰由地中海分遣隊負責，指揮官先後為理查德·達爾與愛德華·普里布爾，另有私掠船與商船武裝自保的體系。英國、西班牙與歐洲列強保持中立但各有算盤：英國擔心美國的勝利削弱自己在地中海的商業地位，同時又倚賴巴巴利港口作對法貿易的轉口；西班牙與巴巴利國家爭鬥數百年，此時正被拿破崙戰爭拖住而無力介入，英國商船在直布羅陀與地中海航線上對美國施加的壓力，成為美國的次要難題。
countriesEn: The opposing sides were not two states but two systems confronting each other: a Barbary alliance of North African city-states on one hand, and the United States on the other. The Barbary side was made up of three autonomous polities. Tripoli was the main theatre; in 1801 it was ruled by Yusuf Karamanli in the capacity of Dey, with a council drawn from merchants, seamen and officers and a fiscal administration of diwan officials, and the fleet of the capital numbered some twenty-odd galleys and xebecs carrying 6- to 12-pounder long guns and swivel pieces, which made it the effective controller of the central Mediterranean lanes. Algiers was the strongest of the three, its corsair fleet ranging from several dozen vessels to nearly a hundred, and in 1801, under Mustafa, it sent aid to Tripoli. Tunis, ruled by the Muradid dynasty, possessed a smaller fleet but lived on plunder all the same, and also declared war on the United States in 1801. The Sultan of Morocco declared war in October 1800 over a quarrel of customs and detained shipping, and the two sides settled the affair by treaty at Washington in January of the following year without a shot being fired. The American side was a republic barely a decade old: Congress provided the money and the Navy Department administered the war, but the actual fighting was done by a Mediterranean detachment under such commanders as Richard Dale and Edward Preble, supported by privateers and by armed merchantmen. Britain, Spain and the continental powers stayed neutral, but each had its own calculation. British opinion was uneasy at the prospect of an American success weakening British commerce in the Mediterranean, and British trade with the French enemy relied on the Barbary ports as transhipment stations; Spain, after centuries of contest with the Barbary states, was now bogged down in the Napoleonic wars and unable to intervene, while the pressure British shipping exerted on American merchants in the Strait of Gibraltar and the Mediterranean became a secondary complication for Washington.
people: 美方關鍵人物集中在少數幾個位置。亞當斯政府作出「寧戰不貢」的決定，總統傑佛遜起初仍寄望談判，最後批准分遣艦隊巡航地中海；海軍部長羅伯特·史密斯與駐的黎波里領事喬治·伊利都捲入衝突，伊利在一八〇一年被驅逐，成為開戰的導火線。海上由理查德·達爾少將率領一支由三艘四十四炮巡防艦（費城號、憲法號、總統號）、一艘十八炮單桅帆船（大黃蜂號）與一艘小型炮艇組成的小分隊；炮艇艇長亞歷山大·穆雷於一八〇一年五月三十一日在的黎波里港內俘獲一艘的黎波里商船，交戰後第一個勝果由此而來。威廉·班布里奇上校在「費城」號被俘時是艦長，後於一八〇三年率三艘小艦摧毀蘇斯的黎波里分艦隊，再成為地中海分遣隊指揮官。愛德華·普里布爾少將於一八〇三年接任，主持對的黎波里的封鎖與炮擊；約翰·羅傑斯上校以「憲法」號在敘利亞海岸與的黎波里外海巡航護航，他與艾薩克·赫爾、奧利弗·佩里等人是新一代海軍軍官的代表。巴巴利一方的主角是優素福·卡拉曼利，他派遣阿明貝伊等使節周旋於美國、突尼斯與英國之間；突尼斯的哈穆達帕夏、阿爾及爾的穆斯塔法與艾哈邁德德伊各有算盤，卻始終不肯放棄掠奪。戰爭末段最關鍵的是阿爾及爾首領哈姆扎，他率「阿爾巴尼人」部隊在英國海軍掩護下於一八〇五年五月攻入的黎波里在昔蘭尼加的據點傑爾奈，替的黎波里切斷陸地退路。英國方面並未參戰，但其地中海貿易與英國商船的安全才是其計算的真正起點。
peopleEn: The decisive figures on the American side occupied only a few positions. The Adams administration took the decision to fight rather than pay; President Jefferson at first still hoped for a negotiated settlement and only at the end approved the cruising of the detachment in the Mediterranean. Secretary of the Navy Robert Smith and George Ely, the American consul at Tripoli, were both drawn into the quarrel, and Ely's expulsion in 1801 became the spark that set the war alight. At sea the small squadron was led by Commodore Richard Dale, with three 44-gun frigates (Philadelphia, Constitution and President), an 18-gun sloop (Hornet) and one small gunboat. The gunboat's commander, Alexander Murray, captured a Tripolitan merchantman inside the harbour of Tripoli on 31 May 1801, and the first prize of the war came from that action. Colonel William Bainbridge was the captain of Philadelphia when it was taken, and in 1803 he led three small vessels against the Tripolitan squadron at Sousse before becoming commander of the Mediterranean detachment. Commodore Edward Preble took over in 1803 and directed the blockade and the bombardment of Tripoli; Captain John Rodgers cruised with the Constitution along the Syrian coast and off Tripoli on escort duty, and he, Isaac Hull and Oliver Hazard Perry were the representatives of the new generation of naval officers. On the Barbary side the central figure was Yusuf Karamanli, who sent envoys such as Amin Bey circling among the United States, Tunis and Britain. Hammuda Pasha of Tunis, and Mustafa and Ahmed Dey of Algiers, each pursued their own interest and none would give up plunder. The most consequential man of the closing phase was Hamza of Algiers, who with his Arnaut troops and under British naval cover took the Tripolitan stronghold of Derna in Cyrenaica in May 1805, cutting Tripoli's landward retreat. Britain did not fight, but Mediterranean trade and the safety of British shipping were the true starting point of its calculations.
kits: 輪發手槍在這場戰爭裡的位置，是一件「正在退場的貴重舊物」：它是十五世紀末、十六世紀初的後膛火器，機械須用專用鑰匙上弦，機件造價遠高於前裝火槍，所以從來只配給火槍隊的軍官與近衛。一八〇一年的北非軍械庫裡仍存有數百支歐洲製輪發手槍，其中不少出自西班牙與威尼斯作坊，另有相當數量是把前裝火槍改裝成後膛的折衷型；它們是德伊、帕夏與私掠船首的佩槍，掛在腰間作儀仗、護衛與登船格鬥之用，海員與商人也當作貴重私人物品攜帶。真正用於交戰的是新舊參半的火器：私掠快船上的水手使用歐洲輸出的前裝滑膛燧發火槍與滑膛手槍，也雜有火繩槍；船上主炮是六至十二磅長管炮，另配半磅或一磅的旋轉小炮，置於船首船尾供登船與追擊使用；登岸的「阿爾巴尼人」與陸軍則以火槍配合彎刀、短矛與火槳作戰。的黎波里城牆與海濱炮台架設十二至二十四磅海岸炮，掩護商港與船塢。美國方面，巡防艦裝四十四炮，單桅帆船與武裝商船承擔封鎖與偵察；一八〇四年十二月三十日，賽默斯少校駕駛裝載火藥桶與易燃物料的縱帆小艇「勇毅號」突入的黎波里港，點燃泊於港內的數艘的黎波里船，是這場戰爭中最大膽的一次裝備運用。載運方面，分遣隊靠艦上儲糧與在西西里、馬耳他、突尼斯的商業補給維持，冬季地中海常起西北季風，橫渡需時數週，暴風曾使分隊失散，並直接造成費城號被俘。
kitsEn: The place of the wheellock pistol in this war was that of an expensive relic on the way out. It was a rear-loading firearm of the late fifteenth and early sixteenth century, its mechanism wound up with a special key, its working parts far costlier than those of a muzzleloader, and for that reason it was never issued beyond the officers and guards of the musket companies. The arsenals of North Africa in 1801 still held several hundred European-made wheellock pistols, many of them from Spanish and Venetian workshops, and a good number were compromise pieces converted from muzzleloading arms. They were the sidearms of the Dey, of the pashas and of corsair captains, worn at the belt for parade, for guard duty and for boarding, and seamen and merchants carried them as costly personal possessions. What actually fought was a mixture of old and new: the men in the corsair galleys used muzzle-loading smoothbore flintlock muskets and flintlock pistols bought from European makers, mixed in with matchlocks. The main guns of the fast galleys were 6- to 12-pounder long pieces, with half-pounder and one-pounder swivel guns mounted at bow and stern for boarding and pursuit; the Arnauts who landed ashore fought with musket, scimitar, javelin and oar. The walls of Tripoli and the batteries along its shore carried 12- to 24-pounder coasting guns covering the commercial port and its dockyard. On the American side the frigates carried forty-four guns, while sloops and armed merchantmen carried out the blockade and the scouting. On 30 December 1804 Lieutenant Somers took the small schooner Intrepid, loaded with powder barrels and combustibles, into the harbour of Tripoli and set fire to several Tripolitan ships lying there, the most audacious use of equipment in the whole war. In the matter of supply, the detachment lived on its own stores and on commercial resupply at Sicily, Malta and Tunis; the north-westerly gales of the Mediterranean winter took weeks to cross, storms had already scattered the squadron once, and a storm was directly responsible for the loss of Philadelphia.
tactics: 巴巴利一方採取的是典型海盜式掠奪：以吃水淺、轉向靈活的縱帆快船在商船航線上埋伏，晝夜兼行、避開大艦，單獨攻擊商船，奪船後向船主索贖金，扣押水手充當人質甚至賣作奴隸；遇強敵則散入港所，利用岸炮與狹窄水道遲滯追擊。美國在策略上以「封鎖加炮擊」對付：普里布爾分隊以五艘巡防艦在的黎波里港口外列陣，切斷私掠船出港，同時對城內建築與軍械庫射擊，一八〇三年八月二十一日一日之內發射數百發炮彈，企圖以城市受創換取談判。奪船作戰是另一條路徑：一八〇一年八月五日夜，達爾分隊派六十人登上錨泊於港內的兩艘的黎波里炮艇，將其奪回；同年年底，的黎波里軍隊一度圍攻西迪巴拉尼的美國領事館與商站，「憲法」號逼近而迫使解圍。火攻則是破壞性的手段：勇毅號帶著火藥桶在夜裡順風突入港口，與港內船隻同歸於盡，使的黎波里損失數艘戰船。陸戰方面，一八〇五年英國以兩三艘小型護衛艦在海上掩護，阿爾巴尼人部隊在傑爾奈登陸，攻城後占據昔蘭尼加，奪走的黎波里向埃及與敘利亞走私的陸路與海上通道，切斷其外銷與外購的血管。整體而言，這是一場以少量快速艦艇對大量分散小型掠奪者的非對稱消耗戰，勝負不在單次會戰，而在港口封鎖是否封得住、每一次夜襲與炮擊的得失能否累積成對方無法承受的損失。
tacticsEn: The Barbary side fought as classic pirates. Swift xebecs of shallow draught and great handiness lay in wait along the merchant lanes, ran by day and by night, avoided the heavy ships, and struck at lone merchantmen one by one; after taking a prize they demanded ransom from the owner, held the crew for ransom and even sold them into slavery. Against a stronger adversary they would break off into their harbours and use the shore guns and the narrow channels to delay pursuit. The American answer was blockade plus bombardment. Preble's squadron stood off the harbour of Tripoli with five frigates to cut the corsairs off from the sea, while at the same time firing into the buildings and the arsenals inside the town; on 21 August 1803 the squadron discharged several hundred rounds in a single day, in the hope that damage to the city would bring the Dey to terms. Seizure by boarding was a second road. On the night of 5 August 1801 Dale sent sixty men across to the two Tripolitan gunboats riding at anchor in the harbour and took them back. Later that same year the Tripolitan forces besieged the American consulate and factory at Sidi Barrani, and the approach of the Constitution forced them to withdraw. Fire attack was the instrument of destruction: the Intrepid went down the wind at night with her powder barrels, into the harbour and to ruin along with the ships lying there, and Tripoli lost several men-of-war. On land, in 1805, Britain covered the operation with two or three small frigates while the Arnauts landed at Derna; by taking the town they seized Cyrenaica and cut the land and sea routes by which Tripoli bought and sold with Egypt and Syria. On the whole this was an asymmetric war of attrition between a handful of fast warships and a great scatter of small predators, and the decision did not turn on any single engagement but on whether the blockade could be made to hold and whether the sum of night raids and bombardments could accumulate into losses the other side could not bear.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。一八〇一年美國地中海分隊共五艘：費城號、憲法號、總統號三艘四十四炮巡防艦，十八炮單桅帆船大黃蜂號，以及一艘單管小型炮艇；一八〇三年普里布爾接任後擴至五艘巡防艦，另加葛瑞里耶號與合眾國號，全軍在冊官兵約一千數百人。一八〇一年五月三十一日，穆雷率炮艇在的黎波里港內俘獲一艘的黎波里商船；八月五日夜奪兩艘港內炮艇時，美軍出動六十人，傷亡為數人陣亡、數人受傷。一八〇二年五月二十八日，費城號在的黎波里外海遇暴風被打斷桅杆，隨即被數艘的黎波里炮艇圍攻俘獲，該艦當日陣亡三人、受傷十餘人，其後被囚約兩年。一八〇三年八月三日，班布里奇率三艘小艦在蘇斯摧毀的黎波里分艦隊，擊毀兩艘巡防艦、一艘巡航艦與數艘小型船，俘三艘；八月二十一日炮擊的黎波里，五艘船一日發射約三百發炮彈；九月十日暴風中又截獲一艘的黎波里大型軍艦。一八〇四年十二月三十日，勇毅號載二十餘人突入港內引燃泊船，賽默斯少校陣亡，僅一名倖存。一八〇五年五月二十七日，哈姆扎的部隊攻佔傑爾奈。和約條件方面，的黎波里於一八〇五年六月簽約，承諾放棄年貢、賠償美國商船損失（金額各家記載略有出入，多作五萬美元上下）、釋放被囚美國人、歸還所奪美國船產；美國則歸還所俘的黎波里船隻並承諾不再進貢。阿爾及爾與突尼斯於同年秋先後與美國訂約，條件相仿，僅保留一筆年禮（記載多作約二萬五千美元）。整場戰爭中美國軍人的傷亡總數極低，通常估計在百餘人以內，遠低於同時期任何一場歐洲戰爭；而巴巴利方面的損失難以精確統計，被美軍摧毀或俘獲的的黎波里船隻至少有十艘上下，阿爾及爾私掠船隊亦在同期被英國與歐洲私掠船削弱。距離與時間方面，紐約經直布羅陀至的黎波里約需三至四個月，夏季地中海偶有乾熱的西羅科風，冬季常起西北季風與暴風，一八〇二年五月與一八〇三年九月的兩次行動都因大風受挫。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The American Mediterranean detachment in 1801 numbered five vessels in all: the three 44-gun frigates Philadelphia, Constitution and President, the 18-gun sloop Hornet, and a single-gun small gunboat. When Preble took over in 1803 the force was raised to five frigates, adding the Guerriere and the United States, and the total naval establishment was of the order of a thousand to fifteen hundred officers and men. On 31 May 1801 Murray captured a Tripolitan merchantman inside the harbour of Tripoli with his gunboat; on the night of 5 August the boarding party of sixty men who seized the two Tripolitan gunboats at anchor lost several men killed and several wounded. On 28 May 1802 the Philadelphia was dismasted by a gale off Tripoli and then surrounded and captured by a number of Tripolitan gunboats, the ship losing three men killed and more than a dozen wounded that day, and her people remained prisoners for about two years. On 3 August 1803 Bainbridge, with three small vessels, destroyed the Tripolitan squadron at Sousse, destroying two frigates, a corvette and several small craft and taking three prizes; on 21 August the five ships of the squadron fired some three hundred rounds into Tripoli in a single day; and on 10 September a gale enabled them to intercept and capture a large Tripolitan man-of-war. On 30 December 1804 the Intrepid, with some twenty-odd men, entered the harbour and fired the ships at their moorings, Lieutenant Somers being killed and a single man surviving. On 27 May 1805 Hamza's troops occupied Derna. As for the terms of peace, Tripoli signed in June 1805 undertaking to abandon the tribute, to make good the losses of American shipping (the amounts differ from account to account, and are commonly given as some fifty thousand dollars), to release American prisoners and to return the American property it had seized; the United States in return restored the captured Tripolitan ships and promised never to pay tribute again. Algiers and Tunis concluded agreements with the United States in the autumn of the same year on similar terms, keeping only a token annual gift, commonly given as about twenty-five thousand dollars. American military casualties over the whole war were remarkably low, usually estimated at fewer than a hundred, far below any contemporary European war; the Barbary losses cannot be counted exactly, but at least ten Tripolitan vessels were destroyed or captured by the Americans, and the Algerian corsair fleet was likewise worn down at the same time by British and European privateers. As to distance and time, the run from New York by way of Gibraltar to Tripoli took three to four months; the Mediterranean in summer brought dry heat in the sirocco, and in winter the north-westerly gales and storms, and the operations of May 1802 and September 1803 were both spoiled by heavy weather.
cause: 直接起因是北非國家對美國商船的劫掠與「年貢」制度。美國獨立後的地中海商船屢遭的黎波里、阿爾及爾與突尼斯的私掠船襲擊，貨物被奪，船員被扣為人質或淪為奴隸；美方不但要為每一名水手付贖金，還得按年向德伊與帕夏繳納「保護費」，一八〇〇年美國欠的黎波里的款項已達十一萬六千美元上下。一八〇〇年美國曾派遠征分隊前往阿爾及爾要求減免，未能施壓成功，反被對方以數萬之眾的姿態拖延應對，國內輿情隨之高漲。一八〇一年，優素福·卡拉曼利要求把年額提高到原來的一倍，並拒絕照舊交付，隨即驅逐美國領事喬治·伊利，衝突全面化；美國政府則把「寧可打仗也不再進貢」定為公開方針，遂以分遣艦隊代替國庫付款，開啟戰端。摩洛哥方向的起因略為不同：美國商船未依摩洛哥慣例繳付港口稅，又涉及扣押摩方船隻的爭議，摩洛哥於一八〇〇年十月宣戰，但雙方在翌年一月即以條約了結，未成戰事。更深的背景是拿破崙戰爭：歐洲列強在歐洲互相消耗，巴巴利聯盟得以坐大並擴充私掠船隊，弱小的美國海軍既無歐洲的火力，也無歐洲的基地可用。
causeEn: The immediate cause lay in the plundering of American shipping by the North African states and in the system of the annual tribute. Mediterranean American merchantmen were repeatedly seized by the corsairs of Tripoli, Algiers and Tunis, their cargoes taken and their crews held for ransom or sold into slavery; the United States not only paid to redeem every seaman taken but also paid a yearly protection money to the Deys and Pashas, and by 1800 the sum owed to Tripoli had reached something like one hundred and sixteen thousand dollars. In 1800 America sent a squadron to Algiers to obtain a reduction and failed to bring pressure to bear, being answered instead with a parade of tens of thousands of men and endless delay, and feeling at home rose accordingly. In 1801 Yusuf Karamanli demanded that the annual payment be doubled, refused the old sum, and then expelled the American consul George Ely, which brought the quarrel to the point of war; the American government then made open the policy of fighting rather than paying, and opened hostilities by sending a detachment of warships in place of money from the treasury. The Moroccan quarrel had a somewhat different origin: American ships had not paid the customary port dues and there was a dispute over the detention of Moroccan shipping, so Morocco declared war in October 1800, but the two sides settled the matter by treaty in January of the following year without a war being fought. The deeper background was the Napoleonic war. The European powers were consuming one another in Europe, the Barbary alliance was thereby able to grow fat and enlarge its corsair fleets, and a small American navy had neither European gunpower nor European bases to work from.
impact: 影響主要落在三個方向。第一，美國第一次有了可用的海外用兵手段：巡防艦當巡邏快船用、封鎖加炮擊、夜襲奪船、火攻破港，這套做法後來成為美國海軍在地中海與加勒比行動的樣板，也讓「寧戰不貢」成為一八一五年第二次巴巴利戰爭的既定政策，最終促成阿爾及爾在那一年的改朝換代。第二，貿易路徑被改寫：商船為躲避私掠而繞好望角，航程與成本上升，紐約與波士頓的商界對地中海航線的安全與保險成本長期抱怨，這種不滿最終也把美國推向與英國在海上直接對抗的舊怨之中。第三，北非的俘虜問題並未真正解決：和約釋放了一部分被囚美國人與被擄走的船員，但美國在北非既無駐軍據點，亦無外交機構，往後仍有零星的美國水手被擄；美國直到二十世紀才真正在北非取得正式的軍事存在。對巴巴利國家而言，損失是實實在在的：的黎波里在港內損失十艘左右的戰船，元氣大傷，頭號敵人地位下降，在阿爾及爾面前的地位也隨之改變；私人船隊的損失加上與美國同時訂約，令其航線收益明顯下降。歐洲方面，拿破崙戰爭的壓力令各國暫時無暇北顧，巴巴利國家的挑釁得以延續，這正是美國單靠自己的小分隊便能迫使三方各自求和的關鍵條件。
impactEn: The effects fell three ways. First, America gained a workable means of projecting force overseas for the first time: frigates used as fast patrol ships, blockade combined with bombardment, night seizures by boarding, and fire ships sent into the harbour. The method became the model for later American operations in the Mediterranean and the Caribbean, and the policy of fighting rather than paying was carried into the Second Barbary War of 1815, in the end contributing to the change of rule in Algiers in that year. Second, the trade routes were rewritten. To avoid the corsairs, merchantmen went by the Cape, so the passages lengthened and the costs rose, and the merchants of New York and Boston complained for years about the security of the Mediterranean lanes and the cost of insurance; that resentment eventually fed the older quarrel with Britain at sea. Third, the problem of the captives in North Africa was not truly solved. The treaties released a portion of the imprisoned Americans and the enslaved seamen, but the United States had neither a garrison nor a diplomatic agency in North Africa, and stray American sailors continued to be carried off; a formal American military presence in North Africa came only in the twentieth century. For the Barbary states the losses were real. Tripoli lost around ten warships inside its own harbour, was badly shaken, and saw its standing as the leading enemy of the United States fall, and with it its position in relation to Algiers. The loss of private shipping and the simultaneous conclusion of treaties with America visibly reduced the returns of their trade routes. In Europe the pressure of the Napoleonic wars kept the powers from looking north, so that the defiance of the Barbary states could continue, and that was exactly the condition that allowed a small American detachment to force all three of them separately to seek terms.
result: 結果是有限的成功，而且成功的方式非常明確。的黎波里於一八〇五年六月先行求和，條款包括放棄年貢要求、賠償美國商船損失並分期支付、釋放被囚美國人、歸還所奪走的美國船產；美國則歸還所俘的黎波里船隻與船員，並承諾不再交付年貢。阿爾及爾與突尼斯在同年秋分別與美國訂立和約，條文相仿，僅保留一筆象徵性的年禮；摩洛哥早於一八〇一年一月便以華盛頓條約取得自由貿易與最惠國待遇，戰爭未打成。軍事上，美國沒有攻下任何一座北非城市，沒有佔領一寸北非土地，也沒有推翻任何一位德伊或帕夏，卻靠封鎖、炮擊、夜襲與火攻摧毀或俘獲的黎波里戰船至少十艘，使的黎波里在一八〇六年後再無能力挑戰美國商船。阿爾及爾的私掠船隊在戰後仍舊活躍，直到一八一五年第二次巴巴利戰爭中才被真正削弱，而那時採取主動攻擊的反而是英國而不是美國。就戰役評價而言，這是美國海軍第一次成功的海外行動：參與規模小、耗費不大、美軍傷亡極少，卻換來了美國商船在地中海的實際通行權，也確立了以海軍而非以錢袋解決爭端的做法；其陰影則是，美國在北非沒有留下任何制度性成果，北非各國的私掠與奴役體制並未因此改變，衝突只被推遲到下一代美國海軍更強盛的時候。
resultEn: The result was a limited success, and a very clear one. Tripoli sued for terms first, in June 1805, undertaking to drop the demand for tribute, to make good the losses of American shipping in instalments, to release the imprisoned Americans and to return the American property it had taken; the United States in return gave back the captured Tripolitan ships and crews and promised never to pay tribute again. Algiers and Tunis concluded treaties with the United States in the autumn of the same year, on similar terms, keeping only a token annual gift; Morocco, in January 1801, had already obtained freedom of trade and most-favoured-nation treatment by the Washington treaty, and no war was fought there at all. Militarily the United States took no North African city, occupied no land and overthrew neither a Dey nor a pasha, yet by blockade, bombardment, night raids and fire ships it destroyed or captured at least ten Tripolitan warships, and Tripoli was no longer able to challenge American shipping after 1806. The Algerian corsair fleet went on working after the war and was not really weakened until the Second Barbary War of 1815, when it was Britain rather than America that took the offensive. Judged as a campaign, this was the first successful American overseas operation: few ships engaged, modest cost, very few American dead, and in exchange the practical freedom of the Mediterranean for American merchantmen, together with the settled principle that disputes would be met with warships rather than with money from the treasury. The shadow over it is that America left no institutional result in North Africa, that the corsair and slave systems of the Barbary states were not changed by the war, and that the conflict was merely deferred to the day when a stronger American navy would take it up again.
